CoverageNotice: Some route-specific and feature-page text is not translated yet.
TestCenterIntro: Read-only checks validate runtime, route bindings, registered actions, local data, recovery state and telemetry. Network integrations require separate consent; elevated mutation tests are not run here.
NoTestRuns: No test runs have been recorded.
SettingsDataScope: Only theme, goal, detail level, language and sidebar preference are exported. Credentials, reports, profiles and recovery history are excluded.
SettingsImportConfirmation: Review the settings diff. Import changes only local app preferences; no Windows settings or recovery records are changed.
SettingsResetConfirmation: Reset app preferences to defaults? Reports, profiles, credentials, recovery history and Windows configuration will be kept unchanged.
SettingsResetStatus: Preferences reset. Windows settings and recovery history were not changed.
ReadActualState: Read what Windows and this device actually report. Review evidence before choosing a change.
SmartScanQuickDescription: Read-only Windows, CPU, memory, storage, and power observations.
SmartScanDeepDescription: OS, hardware, device warnings, and exposed settings; coverage depends on Windows providers.
SmartScanGamingDescription: Reads game-related preferences and memory indicators. No FPS capture or automatic tuning.
SmartScanHardwareDescription: Reads WMI-reported CPU, board, memory, and device inventory; unavailable data stays explicit.
SmartScanPrivacyDescription: Read documented machine privacy policies for camera, microphone, location and diagnostic data. Effective per-app access is not inferred.
SmartScanDriversDescription: Read Windows driver metadata and PnP problem codes. No driver installation or vendor-version comparison.
SmartScanNoEvidence: Select supported scopes and run a scan. Scans are read-only; recommendations never apply automatically.
SmartScanHistoryEmpty: No Smart Scan reports are recorded yet.
SmartScanMethodDescription: Results combine reports from selected providers and expose unavailable data or permission gaps. Recommendations are optional. No Windows setting changes without a separate action preview and explicit approval. Privacy audit, dedicated driver health, and FPS benchmarking are not implemented in this scan.
OneClickOverviewDescription: This build can execute registered actions individually. A profile label is not a promise of system-wide optimization or performance improvement.
OneClickSafeDescription: Registered reversible current-user preferences only. Each action requires its own preview, consent, backup, read-back, and rollback record.
OneClickGamingDescription: Optional per-game process priority is managed separately in Game Library. No universal batch or FPS gain is promised.
OneClickUnavailableDetails: No validated action plan is registered for this profile. It does not apply changes.
OneClickWorkflowDescription: Choose a registered action below. Review target and before/after state, approve explicitly, then the engine backs up, applies, reads back, and records recovery.
OneClickBatchUnavailable: Available: explicitly selected preferences only; broader presets remain unimplemented.
LogicalProcessorsMethod: Windows-reported logical processor count; not physical core count.
CpuSensorUnavailable: No validated clock or temperature provider.
CpuPolicyUnavailableDetail: Priority, affinity and processor power-policy changes are NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Clock and temperature require a validated hardware provider. This page does not apply CPU-policy changes.
CpuOptimizationReadOnly: Process scan samples a bounded list across two observations. Access limitations and exited processes are reported; this is not a continuous per-process monitor.
CpuOptimizationNoEvidence: Run a CPU scan to record actual process CPU and working-set observations. The scan does not change Windows settings.
CpuOptimizationHistoryEmpty: No CPU Optimization scans have been saved yet.
GpuProviderNotAvailable: Unavailable: no validated live GPU telemetry provider.
GpuSensorUnavailable: Live utilization, VRAM, temperature and clock are not read from a validated provider. Values are not inferred from AdapterRAM or other WMI fields.
GpuDriverUnavailable: No driver version is available. Run Refresh GPU; provider errors are shown in Evidence.
GpuNoEvidence: Run Refresh GPU to read adapter and driver properties reported by Windows.
GpuNoAdapters: No Windows-reported adapter name matches this filter. Provider errors, if any, are shown in Evidence.
GpuFilterDescription: This filter searches Windows-reported adapter names only; it does not detect vendor capabilities or change graphics settings.
GpuHistoryEmpty: No GPU scans have been saved yet.
GameProfileScopeNotice: Profiles are attached to a registered game executable. There is no background auto-detection; starting a session always requires explicit approval.
GameProfileLibraryDetail: Add the game's direct executable, then select it to edit its local profile. No profile is applied while editing or saving.
GameProfileNoGames: No game executables are registered. Register a direct game executable or import a local library to begin.
GameProfileCapabilityEditorDetail: Edits local profile settings; changes apply only during a reviewed and approved launch.
GameProfileCapabilityImportDetail: Imports a validated local JSON library. Importing does not change Windows settings.
GameProfileCapabilityHistoryDetail: Shows real recorded per-game actions; no example history is generated.
GameProfileAutoApplyUnavailable: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Background game detection and silent profile application are disabled.
GameProfileAutoRestoreDetail: After an approved launch, changes are restored when the exact registered process exits. Restart recovery requires a verified process identity; otherwise use manual restore.
GameProfileNamePolicy: Profile identity is the registered game name and executable path. Independent profile naming is not supported.
GameProfileUsePowerPlan: Use selected power plan during the session
GameProfileDisableCapture: Disable the Windows game-capture preference during the session
GameProfileDisableTransparency: Disable the current-user transparency preference during the session
GameProfileRaisePriority: Offer AboveNormal priority for this game process after launch (separate approval; no FPS guarantee)
GameProfileApprovalNotice: Launching previews each registered change and requires confirmation. Priority is reviewed separately after the game starts.
GameProfileNoEvidence: Run a read-only scan to match accessible running processes to registered executable paths. The scan does not launch a game or change Windows.
GameProfileHistoryEmpty: No per-game system actions have been recorded.
GameProfileSafetyDetail: Automatic profile activation is not implemented. Session changes require explicit approval, backup and verification; automatic restore is armed only for a verified process identity.
GameProfileExportNotice: Library export contains game names, profile settings and full executable paths. Review the destination and share only with consent.
Name: Name
MemoryGuard: Memory Guard · alerts only; no automatic purge
MemoryGuardRecommendation: Save your work and review memory-intensive processes. No automatic memory purge or process termination is performed.
DetailLevelSafety: Detail level · Safety Guard is always active
LocalDiagnosticsOnly: Local diagnostics only. Cloud sync, analytics, crash upload, AI providers, plugins and automatic optimization are inactive in this build. The application does not start with Windows or run after you close it.
BuildInfo:

Full legacy parity, signed updates, elevated repair, gaming session automation and hardware-lab release gates remain pending.
SupportBundleConsent: Run a scan on a Center, then export its results. The support bundle only includes metadata shown in its preview.
CleanupExplanation: Quarantine selected temporary files with backup and restore. Quarantined files still use disk space; use Windows Storage Settings for permanent cleanup.
DnsResultRecorded: DNS check recorded. Review resolution status and timing in the report; no network settings changed.
NoHistoryEntries: No entries means no managed changes have been recorded. Recovery does not depend on a license or cloud service.
OnlineRequestsOptIn: Online requests are opt-in and previewed. AI can suggest registered actions; it cannot run shell commands or modify Windows. Offline analysis requires no key.
ModelCatalogFilter: Model catalog filter (optional; up to 10 matching candidates)
QuestionMostRecentReport: Question about the most recent report
DiscordDataDisclosure: Only app version, error category/code and timestamp are sent. Raw logs, diagnostic reports and credentials are excluded. Failed delivery remains in local history.
EnableErrorMetadataDelivery: Enable error metadata delivery (requires privacy consent)
WebhookConsent: Send error notifications to your saved Discord webhook? Only app version, category, error code and timestamp are sent. No raw logs, usernames, paths or scan results are included. Delivery is limited to one attempt per minute and can be disabled at any time.
WebhookConfigurationRequired: Save a valid HTTPS Discord webhook URL before enabling delivery.
WebhookSavedStatus: Webhook saved with DPAPI. Enable delivery only after reviewing the consent prompt.
NoScanYet: No scan yet. Select Scan / Refresh.
ReadyStatus: Ready. Scan first; changes always require approval.
RegisteredActionsRequireReview: Registered actions require preview and approval.
ReadinessMeasurementSaved: Readiness snapshot saved; no Windows settings changed.
ReadinessHeuristic: Readiness is a measured readiness heuristic, not a benchmark.
